overview: Guidelines and requirements for updating address in Aadhaar online via Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) or offline at Aadhaar Seva Kendra (ASK).

requirements.title: Proof of Address (PoA) Document
requirements.description: Upload a valid Proof of Address document from the UIDAI accepted document list in PDF, PNG, or JPEG format (max 2MB for portal, up to 25MB via assistant).
accepted_documents: Electricity / Water / Gas Bill (not older than 3 months)

requirements.title: Aadhaar Linked Mobile OTP Authentication
requirements.description: Registered mobile number must be active to receive a 6-digit One Time Password (OTP) for SSUP submission authentication.

steps: Verify existing demographic data from uploaded Aadhaar document
Select address update and enter new residential address with PIN code
Upload valid Proof of Address (PoA) supporting document
Authenticate submission using 6-digit OTP sent to registered mobile number
Obtain 14-digit Update Request Number (URN) to track update status
